newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sierra Rutile debt forbearance extended.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sierra Rutile debt forbearance extended.

text.p: Consolidated Rutile Ltd said Sierra Rutile Ltd, its joint venture owners and international development banks owed US$45.5 million by Sierra Rutile executed a debt forbearance extension agreement last Friday.
The agreement extends to July 1, 1997, and permits Sierra Rutile a further six months to finalise plans to re-start its rutile mine in Sierra Leone, ConsRutile said.
The mine was overrun by rebels in January 1995.
Sierra Rutile is owned 50/50 by ConsRutile and Nord Resources Corp of the U.S.

Implementation of long term security at the mine site, re-financing for the re-start and a revised operating agreement with the government of Sierra Leone will be undertaken in that time, ConsRutile said.
A peace agreement was signed by the Sierra Leone government and the rebels on November 30.
